✨ discussion-downloader | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To easily export and archive Claude AI conversations in a structured Markdown format for personal notes, documentation, or further analysis.
✨ Key Features: • Saves entire conversations from claude.ai to Markdown • Preserves original formatting (code blocks, lists, tables) • Includes YAML header with metadata (title, source, model, dates, message count) • Generates a clean, understandable filename
📖 Summary: Discussion Downloader is a Chrome extension that allows users to save entire conversations from claude.ai into a Markdown file with a single click. It preserves the original formatting, including code blocks, lists, and tables, and adds a YAML header with metadata for easy organization.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ nullframe | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide developers and designers with a visually engaging and performant real-time dashboard of browser performance metrics, styled according to the Nothing design language.
✨ Key Features: • Live telemetry dashboard • Nothing design language aesthetic (dot-matrix numerals, glyph-grid icon reel)
📖 Summary: Project Nullframe is a live telemetry dashboard designed with the Nothing design language. It displays real-time browser performance metrics like frame rate, memory usage, battery status, and network information using a distinctive dot-matrix aesthetic and industrial instrument panel style.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 dnsglobe | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Monitoring and visualizing DNS record propagation across a wide range of global DNS resolvers directly from the terminal.
✨ Key Features: • Global DNS propagation checking across 34 resolvers • Terminal User Interface (TUI) with world map visualization • Real-time monitoring with watch mode • Direct querying of resolvers with EDNS0 and TCP fallback • Grouping of identical answers for round-robin DNS
📖 Summary: dnsglobe is a terminal-based TUI application written in Rust that checks DNS record propagation across 34 global public DNS resolvers. It visualizes the results on a world map within the terminal, allowing users to monitor DNS changes in real-time.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 Infographic | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Generating and rendering infographics, making information presentation more efficient and data storytelling simpler, with AI assistance.
✨ Key Features: • AI-friendly configuration and syntax for AI generation • Support for AI streaming output and rendering • Approximately 200 built-in infographic templates, components, and layouts
📖 Summary: AntV Infographic is a declarative infographic visualization engine that uses AI to generate and render high-quality infographics. It offers a rich set of features including AI-friendly configuration, numerous templates, a theme system, and a built-in editor, all while outputting high-quality SVG.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
